title: HostSendSummaryDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one organizer Send for the Host Sends history and the automation message picker: a WhatsApp campaign, an event announcement or a follower update, with exactly the row listOrganizerCampaigns returns for it. The view id is the kind and the source id (campaign_{campaignId}, announcement_{broadcastId}, followerUpdate_{postId}). Written by triggers on organizerCampaigns, organizerBroadcastSummaries, organizer posts, organizerPostDeliveryOperations, and on template and saved audience renames. A follower update's WhatsApp leg campaign has no row of its own. Never message bodies, recipients, contact ids or delivery evidence, and never identity, permission or mutation authority.
